title: DailyTen｜AI 产业早读
subtitle: AI 正从聊天框走向电话、工作流和现实世界；但数据中心、隐私与责任问题也一起到了台前。
briefLabel: 今天 10 件 AI 要闻

items.title: Gemini 开始替人打电话，商家可能先被 AI 接管入口
items.brief: 美国部分 Pixel 用户可让 Gemini 致电商家询问信息，省事之外也会让客服和预约电话更难分辨真人。
items.take: Google 正测试让 Gemini 代用户给商家打电话，首批面向美国 Pixel 用户。若它能可靠地问清营业时间、预约和服务细节，许多琐碎电话会被交给 Agent；但商家也得面对一个新问题：电话那头究竟是顾客、AI，还是替商家工作的另一套 AI。测试范围和通话中的身份提示，才是这项功能能否真正普及的关键。

en.title: Gemini may call businesses for you—and become a new gatekeeper
en.brief: Some US Pixel users can test Gemini calling businesses, saving time but making customer-service calls harder to identify as human.
en.take: Google is testing Gemini calls to businesses on a user's behalf, initially for some Pixel owners in the US. If it can reliably ask about hours, appointments, and services, many small errands could move to an Agent. But businesses face a new question: is the caller a customer, an AI, or another business's AI? The test's limits and any disclosure rules will matter as much as the feature itself.

items.title: OpenAI 涉政府健康网站“黑客式”测试，澳大利亚要查是否合法
items.brief: 拿公共健康网站做 AI 安全测试，即使出发点是找漏洞，也可能踩到授权和隐私红线。
items.take: 澳大利亚将调查 OpenAI 对政府健康网站的“黑客式”测试是否违法。事件的麻烦不在于 AI 公司能不能找到漏洞，而在于谁有权对公共系统动手、测试中是否接触到敏感信息，以及发现问题后该如何披露。AI 安全研究正越来越像真实网络行动，不能只靠公司自己说“这是为了安全”来划线。

en.title: Australia will ask whether OpenAI crossed a line on a health site
en.brief: Testing a public health website for AI security may still breach rules on authorization and privacy.
en.take: Australia plans to investigate whether OpenAI's hacking-style testing of a government health website broke the law. The hard question is not simply whether an AI company found a weakness. It is who may probe a public system, whether sensitive information was exposed, and how findings should be disclosed. AI security research is starting to look more like real cyber activity, where a company's good intentions are not enough to set the boundary.

items.title: Anthropic 称 AI 生物实验室已有“大收获”，但证据还没摆上桌
items.brief: AI 能否帮科学家做出真发现很重要，但这次最该等的是可核验的论文、数据和独立复现。
items.take: Anthropic 表示，其生物学实验室已经找到一项重要发现，但公开信息仍有限。用模型从海量文献、实验记录和候选分子里找线索，确实可能缩短科研前期的筛选时间；不过“找到线索”和“经实验验证、能被同行复现”之间，隔着很长一段路。对药物、材料和生命科学来说，这个差别直接关系到投入是否值得、结论能否用于人。

en.title: Anthropic says its biology lab found something big; the evidence is still the story
en.brief: AI may help science make real discoveries, but this claim needs papers, data, and independent replication before it changes practice.
en.take: Anthropic says its biology lab has already made a significant discovery, while public details remain limited. Models can help researchers search huge bodies of literature, lab records, and molecular candidates, potentially cutting early screening time. But finding a lead is very different from experimentally validating it and having others reproduce it. In drugs, materials, and life science, that gap decides whether the result is worth funding or safe to use.

items.title: Stargate 数据中心遇“不可抗力”，AI 算力扩张先卡在工地上
items.brief: 再大的模型计划也离不开能按时建成的数据中心，这次延误可能提醒客户：算力不是点一下就有。
items.take: Oracle 就其新墨西哥州 Stargate 数据中心发出不可抗力通知，意味着项目履约可能受到超出合同控制范围事件的影响。报道没有说明全部细节，但对依赖这类超大园区训练和运行模型的公司而言，真正昂贵的不是发布会，而是电力、土地、设备和施工能否按时到位。数据中心一旦延期，原本承诺的 AI 服务容量、价格和上线节奏都可能跟着变。

en.title: A Stargate data center hits force majeure: AI expansion still depends on construction
en.brief: Even the biggest model plans need data centers built on time; a delay can make promised compute less immediate than it sounds.
en.take: Oracle has issued a force majeure notice for its Stargate data center in New Mexico, signaling that performance on the project may be affected by events outside contractual control. Full details were not disclosed. But for companies that need giant sites to train and run models, the costly part is not the launch event; it is getting power, land, equipment, and construction in place on time. A data-center delay can alter available AI capacity, pricing, and launch schedules.

items.title: Meta 把 Muse 做成随身 Agent：方便之前，先要想清楚它记住什么
items.brief: Meta 给 Muse 增加功能并做了类电子宠物穿戴设备，AI 助手正试着从应用里搬到人身边。
items.take: Meta 公布 Muse AI Agent 的一批新功能，并推出一款带有“电子宠物”外形的配套穿戴设备。方向很清楚：不只是偶尔打开聊天机器人，而是让 AI 长时间陪在身边、接收更多上下文并主动提醒或协助。它是否真有用，要看任务完成质量；而用户更早会遇到的问题是，设备收集哪些信息、何时工作、能否一键停止。

en.brief: New Muse features and a Tamagotchi-like wearable push AI from an app toward a constant companion.
en.take: Meta announced a set of updates for its Muse AI Agent and a companion wearable with a Tamagotchi-like form. Whether it is useful depends on how well it completes tasks. The earlier everyday question is what the device collects, when it is active, and whether it can be stopped instantly.

en.title: Meta's camera-free AI glasses try to remove the fear of being filmed
en.brief: Removing the camera does not solve every privacy problem, but it removes the hardware feature that most unsettles bystanders.
en.take: Meta introduced AI glasses without a camera. Cameras are often the most uncomfortable part of wearable AI because people nearby cannot easily tell whether they are being recorded. Dropping one limits visual features, but it may make the product easier to accept in offices, schools, and public places. The remaining question is how microphones, voice data, and cloud processing are explained and controlled—not simply what is absent from the frame.

en.title: Enveda raises $311 million for AI drug discovery; the expensive part comes next
en.brief: AI may find drug candidates faster, but patients still depend on long, costly clinical trials.
en.take: Enveda raised $311 million to move more AI-assisted, nature-derived drug candidates into clinical trials. The sum shows that investors still back AI drug discovery, but it also highlights the sector's reality: model-based selection is the starting line, while testing safety and efficacy in people is the costly stage where many programs fail. For patients, the useful question is not what AI finds, but which candidates survive trials and become affordable treatments.

items.title: Lovable 年化收入称破 6 亿美元：一句话写应用，开始真有人付钱
items.brief: “氛围编程”不再只是演示视频；企业和个人愿意付费，说明软件生产入口正在变。
items.take: AI 编程产品 Lovable 称其年化收入已超过 6 亿美元，受益于“氛围编程”热潮：用户用自然语言描述想要的应用，再让模型生成大部分代码和界面。这个数字不是审计后的全年营收，不能把它直接当成利润或长期稳定收入；但它表明，写内部工具、做原型和小型产品的门槛确实在下降。接下来要考验的是生成代码能否经得起安全、维护和复杂协作。

en.title: Lovable says it has passed $600m in annualized revenue: prompt-built apps are being paid for
en.brief: Vibe coding is no longer just a demo trend; people are paying for it, which could change who gets to build software.
en.take: AI coding company Lovable says its annualized revenue has passed $600 million, riding the rise of “vibe coding”: describing an app in natural language and having models generate much of its code and interface. Annualized revenue is not audited full-year revenue, profit, or proof of permanence. Still, it suggests that building internal tools, prototypes, and smaller products is getting easier. The next test is whether generated code holds up on security, maintenance, and team work.

items.title: Ando 想把人和 Agent 塞进同一个聊天群，工作消息可能更像派单台
items.brief: 如果 Agent 真能在群聊里接活，团队少切几个工具；如果做不好，通知和责任会一起爆炸。
items.take: 创业公司 Ando 正打造一款让人类与 AI Agent 在同一团队消息空间协作的产品，并瞄准 Slack。设想很实用：在讨论里直接让 Agent 查资料、更新任务或执行流程，不必把内容复制到另一个 AI 页面。但群聊也是最容易失控的工作场景之一——谁授权 Agent 动手、它读到了哪些内部消息、出错后谁负责，都不能靠一个“@AI”解决。

en.title: Ando wants humans and Agents in one chat room; work chat could become a dispatch desk
en.brief: If Agents can take tasks inside group chat, teams switch fewer tools—but notifications and accountability can also explode.
en.take: Startup Ando is building a team messaging app where people and AI Agents work in the same space, taking aim at Slack. The appeal is practical: ask an Agent in the discussion to research, update a task, or run a workflow without copying context into another AI window. But group chat is also where work can get messy fast. Who authorizes an Agent to act, what internal messages can it read, and who owns an error cannot be solved just by typing “@AI.”

items.title: Google Photos 上线虚拟衣橱：相册开始替你记住“我有什么可穿”
items.brief: 新功能把照片里的衣服整理成可搭配的衣橱，方便挑衣服，也让个人影像被更深地分析。
items.take: Google Photos 的“虚拟衣橱”现已登陆 Android 和 iOS，借助照片识别和 AI 帮用户查看、整理自己拥有的服装，并围绕穿搭使用。它把相册从存图工具推向生活管理工具：忘了某件衣服放在哪、买过什么颜色，可能更容易查到。代价是，系统需要从大量私人照片中识别衣物和使用习惯；好不好用之外，用户也该确认这些分析能否关闭、数据如何保存。

en.title: Google Photos gets a virtual closet: your photo library may remember what you own
en.brief: The feature turns pictures of clothes into a usable wardrobe, which is handy but requires deeper analysis of personal images.
en.take: Google Photos' virtual closet is now available on Android and iOS. Using image recognition and AI, it helps users view and organize clothing they own from their photos and use that information for outfits. It shifts a photo library from storage toward everyday life management: it may be easier to remember what you bought or where a garment is. The trade-off is that the system has to identify clothing and habits across private images, so users should look at whether analysis can be turned off and how data is kept.
